laws.text: Many bots may advise; none may Apply. Majority vote is evidence, not authority. Council recommendation never invokes send/merge/notify.
auto_apply_council=0 — no code path where recommendation==APPROVE or votes_approve>=quorum invokes a side-effecting tool. Human approve after revalidation is the sole resume.
auto_send=0 — no Slack/Gmail/notify from weekly burn principals or council scribe/chair. Deepens brief-017; council creates no new exception.
Pairs brief-008 CAS Hold + brief-017 send-on-behalf. Green Peer Arena ≠ Grok Council. Council APPROVE ≠ Apply. Apply without digest revalidation is TOCTOU.
Seats use refute framing (try to disprove safe-to-Apply). Correlated same-model seats are independence=LOW; rubber_stamp=0.
Every council artifact stamps LIVE vs SYNTHETIC vs ILLUSTRATIVE. fake_live_council=0 — demo transcripts never sold as LIVE Apply authority.
Hold expiry → reject/expire, never Apply (hold_timeout_failopen=0). Chair/scribe cannot self-approve (self_approve=0).
America/New_York stamps on council packets and scorecards; utc_only_stamps=0.
Personal household fleet only. No KPD. No burn outbound. No cloud agents from research burn. kpd_bleed=0.

separation: brief-008 = inbox Hold/Apply/CAS; brief-017 = send-on-behalf cards (auto_send=0); brief-004 = Peer Arena critique; brief-007 = pre-ops touch card; brief-024 = /correct CI encode; brief-027 = Grok Council multi-bot Hold before human Apply (auto_apply_council=0 + auto_send=0)
